subject: Coord_map() with facet_grid()--setting bounding areas for each facet?

messages.author: 39e7e1f3497b0c49
messages.subject: Coord_map() with facet_grid()--setting bounding areas for each facet?
parts:
I'd like to set the viewable area (ie, using xlim/ylim in coord_map) differently for each window produced by a facet_grid.  Is this possible?

Below is a subset of my data--I'd like to trim the edges of the "west" facet (without messing up the polygons or screwing with the aspect ratio) so that the viewable area roughly corresponds to the edges of the voronoi box (as well as the "east" facet).   Sorry for the long example script:


require(data.table)
require(ggplot2)

all_states <- as.data.table(map_data("state"))

setnames(all_states,"region","state")

weco.states <- c("oregon","washington","california")
west.states <- c("washington","montana", "idaho","utah","nevada","arizona","new mexico",
    "wyoming","colorado","south dakota","texas")
east.states <- c(setdiff(unique(all_states$state), union(weco.states,west.states)),
    "texas","south dakota")
all_states[,c("weco","west","east"):=FALSE]
all_states[state%in% weco.states, weco:=TRUE]
all_states[state%in% west.states, west:=TRUE]
all_states[state%in% east.states, east:=TRUE]


all_states.dup <- rbind(copy(all_states)[state %in% weco.states,region:="weco"], copy(all_states[state=="washington"])[,region:="west"])
all_states.dup[state %in% setdiff(west.states, "washington"), region:="west"]
all_states.dup <- rbind(all_states.dup[state %in% setdiff(east.states, c("texas","south dakota")),region:="east"],
        copy(all_states[state %in% c("texas","south dakota")])[,region:="east"])
all_states.dup[,region:= factor(region, levels=c("weco","west","east"))]
